title: The Receipt Ladder
description: Seven ways to verify what an AI agent claims it did, plotted by latency added against the share of fabricated claims caught. Pick a claim type and watch it route to the cheapest sufficient verifier — a free chain receipt, a 12ms signed receipt, or a zkLLM proof reserved for the inference itself.
controls: pick a claim type to highlight its cheapest sufficient verifier
tap a point to inspect a method
